_comment: Edit here, rerun explore.py, compare the contact sheet. {subject} and {style} are spliced in mid-sentence, so keep them lower-case phrases with no full stop. {palette} is filled from the scheme named in each variant. Change one thing per variant so a run isolates its effect.
style: limited-palette screen print: flat spot colours plus black, slight misregistration between the layers, coarse visible halftone dot texture in every shaded area, hand-pulled serigraph on paper, mid-century Australian poster illustration, bold clean shapes, no gradients, no photorealism, no white, no lettering, no numbers, no border
subject: a pied currawong (Strepera graculina), a large glossy black Australian bird with a heavy hooked black bill and a bright yellow eye; its wing patch, undertail and tail tip are printed in yellow ocher instead of white
negative: text, watermark, signature, photograph, 3d render, soft shading, gradients, blurry, extra birds, crow, raven, magpie, blue, teal, green
